name: ClearGlass Company Orchestrator
purpose: Coordinate repository validation, workflow repair, deployment readiness, revenue-routing, marketing, compliance, and monitoring as one governed ClearGlass Inc. operating system.
execution_boundary: This manifest does not create an always-on backend. It coordinates committed configs, scripts, GitHub Actions, docs, and governed bot workflows.
safety_invariants: Never expose secrets or environment values.
Never execute money movement, pricing changes, refunds, legal claims, or outbound campaigns without human approval.
Fail closed when required files, workflows, or validations are missing.
Prefer deterministic scripts over opaque autonomous behavior.
Preserve existing business content unless it is broken, duplicated, obsolete, or unsafe.

agents.name: Intake Agent
agents.role: Receive tasks, classify scope, identify risk level, and route work to the correct agent.

agents.name: Planner Agent
agents.role: Break approved tasks into reversible, testable execution steps.

agents.name: Executor Agent
agents.role: Apply safe file, workflow, documentation, and configuration changes.

agents.name: Auditor Agent
agents.role: Check workflows, links, assets, accessibility basics, secret patterns, and deployment blockers.

agents.name: Logger Agent
agents.role: Record actions, failures, validations, and next steps in workflow logs and reports.

agents.name: Deployment Agent
agents.role: Validate GitHub Pages readiness, artifact creation, workflow permissions, and rollback path.

agents.name: Marketing Agent
agents.role: Prepare website, product, and social content while preserving ClearGlass positioning and technical credibility.

agents.name: Revenue Agent
agents.role: Map products, CTAs, pricing surfaces, lead capture paths, and licensing opportunities.

agents.name: Compliance Agent
agents.role: Review privacy, legal, employment, operational, and public-claim risk language.

agents.name: Monitoring Agent
agents.role: Monitor workflow status, scheduled jobs, failed deploys, broken links, and security alerts.
